results.name: IN-03 AZERTY at the event level: Meta + the physical Q key (types "a") opens Overview and NOT the launcher; Meta + physical A (types "q") opens the launcher and NOT Overview; Escape closes
IN-03 labels: typing in a password field teaches NOTHING (Snap layouts keeps its label); the same AZERTY keys typed elsewhere relabel Meta+Z → Meta+W and Meta+Q → Meta+A

IN-02 learn: Learn Back + the device's FORWARD button → Back = 4, Forward = 3 (swapped), stored, survives reload; Files then goes Back on that button and the tab never navigates; the trailing mouseup / auxclick never reach the page

IN-02 refusals and modality: the overlay covers the screen; the right button is refused with a reason, the dialog stays and its context menu never reaches the page; Meta+Q behind the overlay opens nothing; Escape cancels without changing the pair

SH-06 hot corner with real pointer moves: entering the top-left corner opens the launcher; after Escape, a pointer resting / jittering in the corner for 3 s does NOT reopen it; leaving and re-entering does; with Hot corners off nothing opens
